scientific_integrity: Finite partition enumeration is an independent check; the infinite result is proved by twin-class and coalition-graph arguments.
scientific_limitations: Connected complete multipartite graphs of order at least three, strict LD-coalition convention; no enumeration of all extremal partitions. Novelty subject to unindexed equivalent literature.
title: A sharp four-block classification for locating-dominating coalitions of complete multipartite graphs
